modules.name: UI/UX Design
modules.description: The visual design direction and design system for the Web and Mobile apps.

requirements.title: Follow platform design standards
requirements.description: The app must follow Material 3 for Android and Apple design guidelines for iOS.

requirements.title: Single design system for Web and Mobile
requirements.description: Web and Mobile must share one design system with the same colours, fonts, spacing, icons and buttons.

requirements.title: Clean, uncrowded screen layout
requirements.description: Screens must have plenty of white space, no crowding and no extra decoration.

requirements.title: Dark mode support (Should Have)
requirements.description: Dark mode is a Should Have item.
